content.short: Stryke is a high-efficiency decentralized options protocol on Arbitrum featuring concentrated liquidity AMMs.
content.description: Stryke is a premier decentralized options platform, formerly known as Dopex, designed to maximize liquidity and capital efficiency for on-chain derivatives. The protocol utilizes a unique Concentrated Liquidity AMM (CLAMM) model that allows liquidity providers to allocate their capital with extreme precision, significantly improving pricing for both buyers and writers. This approach ensures that users can interact with complex option strategies within a transparent and non-custodial environment. Powered by the SYK token, the platform focuses on providing institutional-grade financial tools.
content.meta: Stryke provides professional-grade decentralized options and concentrated liquidity. Discover Stryke and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
